meta.name: learn-codebase
meta.description: Prime a codebase by reading every source file in full. Use when starting work on a new or unfamiliar project, or when the user asks to "learn the codebase", "read the codebase", "prime", or "get up to speed".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速熟悉陌生代码库的完整结构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果刚接手一个不熟悉的项目，需要快速理解代码全貌。
copy.tagline_en: Quickly understand the full structure of an unfamiliar codebase
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just took over an unfamiliar project and need to grasp the codebase quickly.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会系统地把代码库里每一个源文件都完整读一遍,包括用 Read 工具的 offset、limit 参数分块读完大文件,从而建立对该代码库的了解。原文称这一步是必须的。
howto.when: 当你开始接触一个新项目或不熟悉的项目,或提到「learn the codebase」「read the codebase」「prime」等说法、要求快速上手时,它会接管并通读代码库。

say.text: 通读这个项目的全部源代码,把代码库学一遍
say.note: 它会逐个完整读取每个源文件

say.text: 从头学一下这个仓库,大文件分块读
say.note: 大文件用 offset 和 limit 分页读取

say.text: 动手前先把这套陌生代码读透
say.note: 它会在开始改动前先读完整库

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude reads every source file in the codebase in full, paging through large files with the Read tool's offset and limit parameters, to build an understanding of the codebase. The original text calls this non-negotiable.
howto.when_en: It takes over when you start on a new or unfamiliar project, or when you say things like "learn the codebase", "read the codebase", "prime" or ask to get up to speed.

say_en.text: Read through all the source code in this project and learn the codebase
say_en.note: It reads each source file in full

say_en.text: Learn this repo from scratch, reading large files in chunks
say_en.note: Large files are read with offset and limit

say_en.text: Before we touch this unfamiliar code, read it all
say_en.note: It reads the whole codebase before changes
